g.style: fill:#000000; fill-opacity:1.0000;stroke:#000000; stroke-opacity:1.0000; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;

g.text: 5 V model only | 1 kHz PCM at 192 kS/s | idealized switches and transformer

g.desc: 5 V model only | 1 kHz PCM at 192 kS/s | idealized switches and transformer

g.text: Both arms share the same 5 V reference and return. Dots indicate connections; crossings without dots are not connected.

g.desc: Both arms share the same 5 V reference and return. Dots indicate connections; crossings without dots are not connected.

g.text: Follow the wires: PCM bit sources -> ideal SPDT switches -> R-2R ladders -> transformer -> 8 ohm load.

g.desc: Follow the wires: PCM bit sources -> ideal SPDT switches -> R-2R ladders -> transformer -> 8 ohm load.

g.text: No analog amplifier. Transformer model is linear: finite magnetizing inductance, no winding losses or saturation.

g.desc: No analog amplifier. Transformer model is linear: finite magnetizing inductance, no winding losses or saturation.

g.text: SPDT: CTRL=1 selects 5 V; CTRL=0 selects return. Model contains two complementary idealized switches.

g.desc: SPDT: CTRL=1 selects 5 V; CTRL=0 selects return. Model contains two complementary idealized switches.
